Author: Vipin Chandra Dixit
Bench: Vipin Chandra Dixit
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Court No. - 92
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 7332 of 2023
Applicant :- Sunita Devi @ Anita

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Sadrul Islam Jafri,Sr. Advocate Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Vipin Chandra Dixit,J.
Heard Sri Gufran Ahmad Khan, learned Advocate holding brief of Sri Sadrul Islam Jafri, learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.
It is submitted by learned counsel for the applicant that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the present case being Deorani (Sister-in-law) of the deceased.
It is further submitted that the entire family of the husband of the deceased has been roped in the present case by the informant with general allegations.

The similarly placed co-accused namely Sunil Kumar Gaur, Praduman Gaur and Ramesh Prasad having identical role to the present applicant have already been released on bail by the coordinate Bench of this Court, vide orders dated 20.07.2021,
08.02.2023 and 29.01.2021, passed in Criminal Misc. Bail Applications No. 36983 of 2020, 6200 of 2023 and 33759 of 2020; respectively.

entities.text: Criminal Misc. Bail Applications No. 36983 of 2020, 6200 of 2023 and 33759 of 2020

sentences.text: Copies of bail orders have been produced before this Court which are taken on record.
Lastly, it is submitted that the applicant having identical role to the aforesaid co-accused is also entitled to be released on bail on the ground of parity.
The applicant has no previous criminal history and there is no possibility of fleeing away from the judicial process or tampering with the witnesses

entities.text: Sunita Devi @ Anita vs State Of U.P.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The applicant is in jail since 04.01.2023.
Learned A.G.A. for the State vehemently opposed the prayer of bail.
However, he does not dispute the aforesaid facts.

Considering the submissions of learned counsel for the parties, from perusal of the record and considering the complicity of accused, severity of punishment as well as totality of facts and circumstances, at this stage, without commenting on the merits of the case, I find it a fit case for bail.
The bail application is allowed.

Let the applicant Sunita Devi @ Anita be released on bail in Case Crime No. 255 of 2020, under Sections 498A, 304B, 201, 504, 120B I.P.C. & Section 3/4 D.P. Act, registered at Police Station Kotwali, District Deoria, on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Court concerned, subject to the following conditions:
(i) The applicant will not tamper with prosecution evidence and will not harm or harass the victim / complainant in any manner whatsoever.
(ii) The applicant will abide by the orders of the court, will attend the court on every date and will not delay the disposal of trial in any manner whatsoever.
(iii) The applicant will not indulge in any unlawful activity.
(iv) The applicant will not misuse the liberty of bail in any manner whatsoever.

The identity, status and residential proof of sureties will be verified by the court concerned and in case of breach of any of the conditions mentioned above, court concerned will be at liberty to cancel the bail and send the applicant to prison.
